method: Decode each complete JSON context once; do not count readable and lossless views twice. No reconstruction of pre-compaction history. Metadata times retained as stored; their timezone is not independently verified.
coverage: Entire export structurally indexed; root decisions and targeted deployment/runtime descendant evidence semantically reviewed. Not a line-by-line semantic audit of all 730096 lines.
publication_note: Raw export intentionally excluded. Selected excerpts are redacted where needed. Index contains task metadata, not credentials or model reasoning.
